gaps.title: Clinical bridge: what is still unproven?
gaps.detail: These studies do not establish one continuous 2′-FL → Bi-26 → infant allergy/NEC prevention pathway. Prioritize full-text adjudication of EVC001 immune markers and NEC cohorts; keep strain, population, combination products and measured endpoints explicit.

gaps.title: Oral tolerance
gaps.detail: IgE and allergy-related observations are not sufficient to establish oral tolerance. Review the existing source passages before deciding whether more literature is needed.

gaps.title: From culture growth to host benefit
gaps.detail: The records cover different models and interventions. Their sequence does not demonstrate a complete causal pathway.

gaps.title: Recover missing source context
